definition.name: The Main Pursuit — from hollow compliance to the One who chooses
definition.theme_or_dilemma: Self-preservation vs. self-sacrifice, and identity ('Who am I, really?')
definition.summary: Neo's ordinary life of flat deference to an ultimatum (ev-005) is ruptured when he is offered the unbearable truth and swallows the red pill, then reborn into a world where a disembodied voice names him 'the One' before he has any grounds to believe it (ev-008, ev-010, ev-013). He actively resists the title — failing the physical tests, pressing the Oracle's meaning, and finally denying he is the One even as he commits to a rescue that is 'a wager on a man rather than a prophecy' (ev-015, ev-022, ev-032). The chain resolves only when death and revival strip the last doubt away: he refuses the fate Smith pronounces, halts bullets, reads the room as code, and seizes the name by action (ev-039, ev-044, ev-045, ev-047). Each stage conditions the next — the implanted tracker forces the extraction, the extraction forces the awakening, the training exposes his disbelief, and the disbelief makes the final self-chosen leap meaningful rather than predestined.

chain.why_in_plot: The plot opens on Neo's 'flat deference to an ultimatum (ev-005)' — his ordinary life before the rupture. This event is that baseline: Rhineheart delivers an either-or ultimatum and Neo answers with flat, deferential compliance, the exact starting state the summary names.
chain.caused_by_previous: This is the chain's moving part: it establishes the hollow-compliance ordinary world that the later 'unbearable truth' ruptures. Nothing precedes it in this chain; it is the condition the red-pill offer will break.

chain.why_in_plot: The summary's causal spine begins 'the implanted tracker forces the extraction.' This is where Smith animates the fiber-optic tap into a burrowing creature inside Neo — the implant that makes everything downstream necessary.
chain.caused_by_previous: Neo's defiant refusal of Smith's bargain (insulting him, demanding a phone call) is the contempt that drops the negotiation and triggers the implantation — the act that sets the rescue/awakening machinery in motion.

chain.why_in_plot: This is the 'disembodied voice names him the One before he has grounds to believe it' beat (ev-008) and the reclamation that carries him toward Morpheus; it also shows him 'mouthless,' carrying the implanted creature — the direct object of the next event.
chain.caused_by_previous: The tracker implanted in ev-007 is what the crew must now reach and remove; the bug burrowing inside him is the reason Trinity holds him at gunpoint 'for our protection' and why the car stops for the extraction.

chain.why_in_plot: The summary states 'the implanted tracker forces the extraction.' This event is that extraction — Trinity forces the fluke-like bug out of Neo's body, the concrete removal of the ev-007/ev-008 implant.
chain.caused_by_previous: Neo's reclamation into the car in ev-008 places the tracker-bearing body in Trinity's hands; her extractor and electric charge are the direct response to the creature that ev-008 showed burrowing inside him.

chain.why_in_plot: This is the red-pill moment the summary centers ('swallows the red pill,' ev-010): Morpheus reframes Neo's dread as a real enslaving system and offers the choice, and Neo swallows the red pill — the threshold into the world where he will be named the One.
chain.caused_by_previous: With the tracker removed in ev-009, the crew can now safely wire the trace program to Neo and commit to waking him; the cleared body is what enables the red-pill/knowing choice rather than a forced extraction.

chain.why_in_plot: The summary's 'reborn into a world' — Neo is walked through the truth of the Matrix and resists every step ('the training exposes his disbelief' begins here). This is the awakening into the reality that the red pill (ev-010) promised.
chain.caused_by_previous: Swallowing the red pill in ev-010 is what lets Morpheus now jack him in and show the Desert of the Real; Neo's recoil and bodily rejection are the first full expression of the disbelief the plot tracks.

chain.why_in_plot: The summary names Neo 'failing the physical tests' (ev-015). This sparring program is that failure: he downloads technique, claims he knows how to fight, and is dismantled every time — the test that exposes his disbelief in himself.
chain.caused_by_previous: Awakening to the real world in ev-013 (and Morpheus's certainty he is the One) is what commits Morpheus to 'guide him into training,' which produces this combat test as its first physical proving.

chain.why_in_plot: Continues the 'failing the physical tests' strand: the rooftop jump program proves the mind governs the Construct, and Neo runs and falls badly short — another failure rooted in disbelief.
chain.caused_by_previous: The sparring failure in ev-015 pushes Morpheus to a new lesson (the jump) to break Neo's physics-bound thinking; the bad fall is the same disbelief re-expressed at a higher stakes test.

chain.why_in_plot: The summary cites 'pressing the Oracle's meaning' (ev-022). Here Neo presses Morpheus over the five failed candidates and Morpheus confesses he misunderstood the Oracle — the direct engagement with the prophecy's meaning the plot tracks.
chain.caused_by_previous: Neo's accumulated failures (ev-015, ev-016) and the weight of the 'One' claim are what drive him to question the Oracle's words on the way up; the doubt the tests produced now seeks an answer.

chain.why_in_plot: The summary's pivot: Neo 'denies he is the One even as he commits to a rescue that is a wager on a man rather than a prophecy' (ev-032). He explicitly denies being the One and goes back in anyway — disbelief transformed into chosen commitment.
chain.caused_by_previous: Learning Morpheus is captured and about to break (ev-031) is what forces the choice; Neo's denial of the title plus his decision to rescue anyway is the meaningful, self-chosen response the plot builds toward.

chain.why_in_plot: The summary's turn: 'he refuses the fate Smith pronounces' (ev-039). At the edge of death Neo rejects the name and destiny Smith declares and summons an impossible surge — the first crack in his disbelief.
chain.caused_by_previous: The rescue commitment in ev-032 puts Neo back into the Matrix and ultimately into this confrontation; being trapped with Smith (ev-037/ev-038) and nearly killed is what forces the refusal that begins his real transformation.

chain.why_in_plot: The summary's 'death and revival strip the last doubt away.' Neo is shot dead and Trinity's kiss brings him back — the death/revival that clears the final barrier the plot has tracked.
chain.caused_by_previous: Neo's flight to the phone (ev-043) ends with Smith's point-blank shot; the death that results is the necessary precondition for the revival that follows.

chain.why_in_plot: The summary's resolution: 'halts bullets, reads the room as code, and seizes the name by action' (ev-045). Revived, Neo stops the Agents' volley, reads the room as flowing code, and destroys Smith — the fully realized One, doubt stripped away.
chain.caused_by_previous: The revival in ev-044 is what enables the miracle; rising from death, Neo now does what disbelief had blocked — halting bullets and reading code — completing the arc from hollow compliance to self-chosen power.

definition.name: Character Growth — Cypher's trade of meaning for comfort
definition.theme_or_dilemma: Truth vs. a comfortable lie; meaning vs. pleasure
definition.summary: Cypher first voices the self-preservation horn by recasting Morpheus's prophecy as 'a body count' and shaking Neo's faith before the rescue (ev-020), then makes the counter-argument flesh by savoring a fabricated steak and bargaining to be re-plugged into the lie (ev-020). That private bargain conditions the public catastrophe: he engineers the trap that kills Mouse and strands the crew (ev-023), reaches the exit ahead of the others (ev-028), and turns quiet treachery into open murder — killing Apoc and Switch and delivering Morpheus to the Agents (ev-029). His arc is the story's purest statement that choosing empty satisfaction over purposeful struggle costs everyone else, and it is only stopped by Tank, who survived and returns armed (ev-029).

chain.why_in_plot: This is the plot's origin: Cypher voices the self-preservation horn by recasting Morpheus's prophecy as 'a body count' and shaking Neo's faith, then makes the counter-argument flesh by savoring a fabricated steak and bargaining to be re-plugged into the lie. The summary names exactly this dual move.
chain.caused_by_previous: Chain-starter: Cypher's disillusionment and his deal with Agent Smith sets the whole betrayal chain in motion.

chain.why_in_plot: Cypher's private bargain becomes actionable: as the others move toward the car, he covertly connects a phone and drops it in a garbage can in the alley — the planted trace that will let the Agents locate the crew.
chain.caused_by_previous: Enabled by ev-020's deal with Smith: having agreed to deliver the crew, Cypher now installs the tracking device that makes the trap possible.

chain.why_in_plot: The private bargain produces the public catastrophe: Mouse is cornered and killed and the crew is sealed inside the Hotel Lafayette — the trap Cypher engineered.
chain.caused_by_previous: Caused by ev-021's planted phone: the dropped phone is the means by which the Matrix is rewritten around them and the trap closes.

chain.why_in_plot: Cypher's treachery advances as he removes himself from the group under cover: he seems to trip and is lost, hidden by the gas smoke — his exit to reach the ship ahead of the others.
chain.caused_by_previous: Enabled by ev-023's trap: with the crew sealed and fleeing through the wall and basement, Cypher separates from them to get to the exit first.

chain.why_in_plot: The plot marks Cypher's positional advantage: the street group learns that Cypher is already at the exit, confirming he reached the ship ahead of the others.
chain.caused_by_previous: Caused by ev-026's disappearance: having slipped away in the gas smoke, Cypher arrives at the exit before the rest, which the regrouping crew now discovers.

chain.why_in_plot: Cypher reaches the exit ahead of the others: he climbs through the window of the abandoned TV repair shop, and on the ship his body jerks awake and draws a concealed rifle.
chain.caused_by_previous: Caused by ev-027's report that Cypher is already at the exit: he now completes the exit and readies the weapon for the murders to come.

chain.why_in_plot: The arc's climax: Cypher turns quiet treachery into open murder — having shot Tank, he murders Apoc and Switch, delivers Morpheus to the Agents, and stands over the comatose Neo — and is stopped only by Tank, who survived and returns armed.
chain.caused_by_previous: Caused by ev-028's reaching the exit and arming himself: having gotten to the ship first with the rifle, Cypher now executes the killings his deal required.

definition.name: Relationship — Trinity's grief converted into command, then belief
definition.theme_or_dilemma: Trust and faith in another versus self-protective reserve
definition.summary: Trinity begins as the guarded protector who holds Neo at gunpoint 'for our protection. From you' and whose quiet hope at his failed jump breaks her reserve before she withdraws (ev-008, ev-016, ev-017). When Morpheus falls and Neo denies he is the One, she is 'gutted by both' yet converts that grief into command, insisting on the rescue and arming the crew (ev-032). Her arc culminates in refusing to accept Neo's death — she takes hold of his body and kisses him, and the monitors jump back to life — then weeps as she releases the grief she held while watching over him (ev-044, ev-047). The relationship chain runs from distrust to faith to a love that literally calls the One back, each beat earned by the loss that preceded it.

chain.why_in_plot: This is the relationship chain's opening beat: Trinity holds Neo at gunpoint 'for our protection. From you,' establishing her as the guarded protector whose reserve defines the starting point of distrust the plot traces.
chain.caused_by_previous: This is the first entry in the chain; it sets the relationship moving by placing Trinity and Neo together under her armed, wary control.

chain.why_in_plot: During Neo's failed jump, 'Trinity's quiet hope breaks her reserve and then she leaves,' the first crack in her self-protective distance — the plot's stated turn from reserve toward feeling.
chain.caused_by_previous: Her guarded stance established in ev-008 is breached by watching Neo attempt the impossible; his failure draws out a hope she cannot hold back, so the protector begins to feel.

chain.why_in_plot: Trinity emerges from being alone with the unconscious Neo 'in a way she can't own' and deflects Cypher's needling without denying her feelings — the plot's note that she withdraws after her reserve breaks.
chain.caused_by_previous: The hope that broke her reserve in ev-016 leaves her exposed, so she retreats into privacy and defensiveness, protecting the feeling she has just revealed to herself.

chain.why_in_plot: With Morpheus fallen and Neo denying he is the One, Trinity is 'gutted by both' yet 'converts her grief into command,' insisting on the rescue and arming the crew — the plot's central conversion of grief into leadership.
chain.caused_by_previous: The attachment she withdrew from in ev-017 has deepened through the crew's losses, so when grief strikes she does not collapse but channels it into command, arming the crew for the rescue.

chain.why_in_plot: The arc's culmination: Trinity 'refuses to accept Neo's death — she takes hold of his body and kisses him, and the monitors jump back to life,' the love that literally calls the One back, earned by the grief that preceded it.
chain.caused_by_previous: The command born of grief in ev-032 matures into outright refusal of loss; having armed the crew for Morpheus, she now refuses Neo's death itself, and her act of love reverses it.

chain.why_in_plot: The emotional resolution: Neo wakes at her voice and 'she weeps as she kisses him, releasing the grief she held while watching over him,' completing the movement from distrust to faith to love.
chain.caused_by_previous: The miracle she willed in ev-044 is answered — Neo returns — so the grief she converted into command and then into the life-calling kiss is finally released in weeping relief.

definition.name: Antagonist's View — Smith's certainty that the path is written
definition.theme_or_dilemma: Freedom vs. determinism — the hunter who believes the outcome is settled
definition.summary: Smith opens by treating Neo as a record to be managed, laying out his two lives and offering to wipe the 'Anderson' file in exchange for Morpheus (ev-007). He reframes Neo's resistance as settled inevitability, using the arriving train to pronounce his death as fate — the story's loudest claim that choice overrides destiny when Neo refuses the name at that moment (ev-039). The hunter's certainty is what makes his undoing meaningful: Neo enters Smith and bursts out of him, destroying the first Agent ever, 'so the surviving Agents feel fear for the first time' (ev-045). Smith's thread conditions the climax by defining the very determinism Neo must break.

chain.why_in_plot: This is the plot's opening move: Smith treats Neo as a record to be managed, lays out his two lives, and offers to wipe the 'Anderson' file in exchange for Morpheus — the exact 'record to be managed / wipe the Anderson file' beat the summary names as the start of Smith's certainty.
chain.caused_by_previous: Chain origin: ev-006 drives Neo to a ledge he cannot cross and ends with his capture by the Agents, placing him in the interrogation room where Smith can open the negotiation.

chain.why_in_plot: The summary's centerpiece — Smith 'using the arriving train to pronounce his death as fate,' and Neo refusing the name 'at that moment' — is this event, the story's loudest claim that choice overrides destiny from Smith's deterministic viewpoint.
chain.caused_by_previous: Enabled by ev-007's failed negotiation (Smith's first attempt to settle Neo's fate by erasing 'Anderson' and sealing his mouth), which Smith later reframes as settled inevitability in the subway, using the arriving train to pronounce the death he could not secure by interrogation.

chain.why_in_plot: The summary's closing beat — 'Neo enters Smith and bursts out of him, destroying the first Agent ever, so the surviving Agents feel fear for the first time' — is this event, the undoing that Smith's certainty makes meaningful.
chain.caused_by_previous: Enabled by ev-039's refusal of the name/fate Smith pronounces: Neo's rejection of Smith's determinism in the subway conditions the climax where Neo breaks the very determinism Smith defined by destroying the Agent who embodied it.

definition.name: Societal Frame — the crew hunted through a world that is a lie
definition.theme_or_dilemma: Freedom vs. determinism, and truth vs. a comfortable lie, at the level of the collective
definition.summary: The crew operates inside a world revealed to be a simulation where humans are farmed for power, so every escape is a race to a phone before the system rewrites itself around them (ev-013, ev-023). Their causal chain is one of attrition and sacrifice: Morpheus models the self-sacrifice horn by pinning an Agent and ordering Neo out, choosing to give his life so the others escape (ev-025), which leads directly to his capture and interrogation (ev-026, ev-031). The Sentinels press the real-world stakes — the ship hides in a supply line (ev-019), is tracked and struck (ev-036, ev-040, ev-042), and is finally overrun as Neo dives for the phone (ev-046). This frame prices both horns of the central dilemma by showing what self-preservation and self-sacrifice actually cost a community under siege.

chain.why_in_plot: It states the plot's core premise — the world is a simulation and humans are farmed for power — the 'lie' the whole frame is built on.
chain.caused_by_previous: The plot's opening horn is the crew racing a phone before the system rewrites itself; this event is the first explicit naming of that world-as-lie, which the later phone-races (ev-023, ev-046) act out.

chain.why_in_plot: It is the first concrete instance of the system 'rewriting itself around them' (the repeated cat) and forces the phone-race the summary names as the crew's causal engine.
chain.caused_by_previous: Having learned the world is a simulation (ev-013), the crew's movement toward extraction is what the rewriting now traps — the Oracle's death-prophecy and the sealed hotel turn knowledge into a chase.

chain.why_in_plot: It is the self-sacrifice horn the summary centers on: Morpheus pins an Agent and orders Neo out, choosing to give his life so the others escape.
chain.caused_by_previous: The trap closing in ev-023 drives the crew into the wall, so when the Agents converge, Morpheus's ambush-pin and self-sacrificial order are the direct consequence of being cornered by the rewrite.

chain.why_in_plot: It is the direct cost of that sacrifice — Morpheus's capture — which the summary names as the next link ('leads directly to his capture and interrogation').
chain.caused_by_previous: Because Morpheus stayed behind to hold the Agent (ev-025), he is the one left exposed upstairs and taken, while the others flee through the basement.

chain.why_in_plot: It is the interrogation the summary names as the payoff of the capture, pricing what self-sacrifice costs the community.
chain.caused_by_previous: Morpheus's capture (ev-026) delivers him into Smith's hands, so the doubled-serum interrogation that pushes him toward breaking is the direct result.

chain.why_in_plot: It presses the real-world stakes the summary attaches to this frame — the ship hiding in a supply line from a Sentinel.
chain.caused_by_previous: The crew now knows the world is a lie (ev-013) and is operating under siege; the Sentinel sweep is what forces the ship cold into the too-small supply line as its only cover.

chain.why_in_plot: It is the 'tracked and struck' beat the summary lists — the trace fixes their position and a Sentinel strike is ordered.
chain.caused_by_previous: The crew's escape and Neo's stand (ev-036–ev-039) expose their location to the trace, so Brown's fix and Jones's strike order follow directly.

chain.why_in_plot: It is the second 'tracked and struck' beat — the sentinels physically slam down on the ship.
chain.caused_by_previous: The strike ordered in ev-040 lands: the lights go red and the sentinels hit the Nebuchadnezzar in the sewer main.

chain.why_in_plot: It is the 'finally overrun as Neo dives for the phone' beat the summary names — the culmination of both the phone-race and the Sentinel siege.
chain.caused_by_previous: The Sentinel ambush that began in ev-042 and struck in ev-040 overruns the deck, so Neo's dive for the phone at Trinity's 'Now!' is the last possible exit before the ship is lost.
